_meta._doc: ollie · english strings · editorial voice. literal voice variants live in strings.en.literal.json. all keys must exist in both files.

insights.title: this week
insights.subtitle: a quiet look at what you noted.
insights.empty_body: when you log something, it'll gather here. no rush.
insights.pattern_busy_mind: a fuller week of thoughts than usual. that's just what it was.

crisis_screen.title: you're not alone
crisis_screen.intro: this is a quiet page. nothing here is logged. nothing leaves this device.
crisis_screen.breathe_title: breathe with this, if it helps
crisis_screen.breathe_caption: the circle sets the pace. no need to be perfect.
crisis_screen.hotlines_caption: free, confidential, around the clock. pick the place closest to you.
crisis_screen.close_caption: the dump is here when you're ready.
crisis_screen.ground_body: name five things you can see. four you can touch. three you can hear. two you can smell. one you can taste. slowly.

voice.title: voice notes
voice.subtitle: speak. check what was heard. then send it on.
voice.empty_body: tap the circle and say whatever's on your mind. you'll get to read it back before it's filed.
voice.unsupported_body: this browser doesn't offer on-device speech. you can still type on the home screen.
voice.privacy_note: speech is transcribed on your device. transcripts stay here until you send them.

gallery.title: finished things
gallery.subtitle: a shelf for what you've completed. not a scoreboard — just a record.
gallery.empty_body: when you complete a goal or a milestone, it comes to rest here. one day there'll be a shelf.

intro.title: hi.
intro.body: ollie sorts what's in your head into the right places. seven small questions before we start — all skippable.

age.title: what's your age range?
age.sub: just so the copy and defaults fit a bit better. skippable.

country.title: where do you live?
country.sub: so on a hard day i can show the right hotline.

menstr.title: do you track a menstrual cycle?
menstr.sub: if no, the cycle module and cycle-related patterns won't show up at all.

goals.title: what brings you here?
goals.sub: pick anything that resonates · multiple is fine.

confirm.body: write whatever's on your mind into the box below. ollie sorts it. if you're in a crisis, it doesn't go to the pattern engine — a quiet hotline number appears.

pantry.title: pantry staples.
pantry.sub: these are in by default. tap to remove any you don't keep.

subs.title: subscriptions?
subs.sub: tap the ones you have. i'll track renewal dates.

spend_research.title: one more thing.
spend_research.body: you can help us understand how adhd brains spend. anonymous. off by default. change this anytime in settings.

work_time.title: when do you do your best work?

burhan.title: meet burhan. he lives here.
burhan.sub: he'll grow as you use ollie. he's been here since the beginning.

consent.title: module consents.
consent.sub: choose what you want to use.

confirmation.grocery_running_low: toilet paper szn approaching. adding to your list.
confirmation.finance_bill_upcoming: ${0} is due in ${1} days. just saying.
confirmation.fallback_no_match: didn't fit anywhere. kept it as a dump.

empty.cycle_cold:
tell me when your last period started.
no pressure on the date — close is enough.
empty.sleep_cold: a few more nights. then this means something.
empty.finance_none: no money in or out yet.
empty.focus_idle: what are you with right now
empty.astrology_no_birth: tell me when and where you were born.

cta.cycle: log your last period to begin.

insist.rent_due_today: rent is due in ${0} days. just saying.

crisis.opener_with_name: ${0}, this looks rough. you're not alone.
crisis.opener_no_name: this looks rough. you're not alone.
crisis.close: the dump is here when you're ready.

work.b2: deadlines that feel abstract until they are not.
work.b3: task-switch tax, hyperfocus crash, post-meeting drag.
work.b4: log: tasks, focus minutes, what you finished.
work.b5: patterns surface after enough sessions to see a shape.

habits.b1: daily check-ins. no streaks, no chains.
habits.b2: drift detection — patterns that quietly stopped.
habits.b3: luteal collapse, sensory preflight, friction signature.
habits.b4: log: a quick check on the row when you do it.
habits.b5: patterns surface around 2 weeks of data.

goals.b1: 1 thing at a time. why it matters. when by.
goals.b2: graveyard for what you let go of, on purpose.
goals.b3: research-as-progress mirror, identity drift, novelty discount.
goals.b4: log: a goal, an obstacle, a session tag.
goals.b5: cap of 5 active. anything more dilutes attention.

finance.b2: subscriptions you forgot are still active.
finance.b4: log: a recurring bill, a recent purchase.
finance.b5: no bank link. you tell ollie what to track.

admin.b2: paperwork that needs splitting in half.
admin.b3: the last 5% — finishing what you've already started.
admin.b4: log: a task, even something tiny.
admin.b5: cost-of-delay surfaces when a task ages out.

cycle.b1: cycle day, phase, predicted next period as a range.
cycle.b2: health flags that cite a clinician source. never diagnostic.
cycle.b3: fertility framing only if you opt in.
cycle.b4: log: bleed day 1, cramps, mood, fatigue.

sleep.b2: how sleep loss bleeds into mood and focus the next day.
sleep.b4: log: when you went to bed, when you woke up.
sleep.b5: no scoring, no quality star. raw clock only.

body.b2: interoception drift — when your body asks and you forget.
body.b4: log: a glass of water, a pill, a walk.

pets.b1: feeding, vet, supplies for each resident.
pets.b3: vet adherence delay, schedule lapse under stress.
pets.b4: log: add a pet, mark a feed, log a vet visit.
pets.b5: reminders pause when you mark yourself away.

dump.b1: throw any thought here. ollie sorts it.
dump.b3: good for capturing before working memory drops it.
dump.b4: log: type whatever. one line or a paragraph.
dump.b5: review mode lets you check ollie before it commits.

grocery.b1: what is in your pantry, by fill level.
grocery.b3: shopping mode for in-store. recipes for what you have.
grocery.b4: log: dump groceries — milk, eggs, paper towels.
grocery.b5: no streaks. no rewards. just fill levels.

astrology.b4: log: your birth time and place once.

adherence.body: your last cycle came out to ${0} days. that's unusually long. did you miss logging a period, or was it actually that long?

irregular.copy: cycle pattern is variable. no useful phase this month.

day.empty_sub: no period logged yet. use record below to begin.

next.need_logged: need a logged period to predict.

confidence.cold: first prediction — based on typical cycles
confidence.shifting: pattern shifted — using recent cycles only

pattern.body: ${0} have clustered in your ${1} phase across ${2} cycles. pattern, not medical.

fertility.label: tracking for fertility
fertility.sub: shows fertile window estimate when opted in.

birth_control.label: birth control tracking
birth_control.sub: log daily pill. missed-day detection runs after 2 days of history.

pill_type.label: pill type
pill_type.sub: metadata only — no display logic yet.

passphrase.label: backup passphrase hint
passphrase.sub: a hint to remember your .void file password.

patterns.caffeine_sleep: caffeine after ${0} is shifting your sleep. average drop: ${1} min.
patterns.luteal_spending: luteal phase starts ${0}. spending tends up ${1}% for you. energy may dip.
patterns.workout_skip_mood: when workouts drop off, mood follows ${0} days later. pattern across ${1} weeks.
patterns.sleep_debt_habits: sleep debt over ${0}h correlates with habit completion dropping. this week: ${1}h short.
patterns.evening_matcha_sleep: evening matcha is shifting your sleep onset. average: ${0} min later.
patterns.water_focus: hydration below ${0} cups correlates with focus dips. today: ${1} cups.

weekly.normal: week ${0}. ${1} habits complete. sleep avg ${2}h. water avg ${3} cups.
weekly.short_sleep: week ${0}. sleep short by ${1}h total. ${2} habits held.
weekly.sparse: week ${0}. not enough data yet — keep going.

push.sleep_debt_high: sleep short by ${0}h this week. ideal tonight: ${1}.
push.caffeine_cutoff: coffee after ${0} — sleep usually dips ${1} min.

audit.title: audit
audit.subtitle: subscriptions
audit.evidence_paid_unwritten_one: paid 1 time since you last wrote about it, ${0}d ago
audit.evidence_paid_unwritten_many: paid ${0} times since you last wrote about it, ${1}d ago
audit.evidence_paid_never_written_one: paid 1 time. never showed up in your writing.
audit.evidence_paid_never_written_many: paid ${0} times. never showed up in your writing.
audit.evidence_review_one: 1 mention in the last 90 days, ${0}d ago
audit.evidence_review_many: ${0} mentions in the last 90 days, ${1}d ago
audit.evidence_inconclusive_uncatalogued: we couldn't match this to your writing.
audit.evidence_inconclusive_no_charges: no charges in the last 90 days. maybe already cancelled.
audit.evidence_too_soon: added ${0}d ago. too soon to tell.
audit.manual_prompt: used it in the last 30 days?
audit.empty_body: add a subscription on the money screen and we'll start watching.
audit.all_clear_body: everything on your list still shows up in your writing.
audit.disclosure_short: ollie audits subscriptions by comparing your charges with your writing. nothing leaves your device.
audit.disclosure_full: ollie audits your subscriptions by comparing two things you already share with it: how often you're charged, and how often you write about them. nothing leaves your device for this. we cannot see what you do inside netflix — only that netflix shows up in your charge history and not in your words.

push.subscription_stale: ${0} — not opened in ${1} days. still paying${2}.
push.impulse_pause_summary_one: 1 impulse buy paused this month. saved approx ${0}.
push.impulse_pause_summary_many: ${0} impulse buys paused this month. saved approx ${1}.
push.anomaly_detected: this ${0} charge looks unusual. confirm or flag?
push.tax_setaside: tax set-aside · ${0} for ${1}. monthly nudge, not a deadline.
push.cycle_spending: spending tends to shift this phase
push.cycle_spending_body: pattern, not a rule — spending tends to spike around luteal phase
push.adhd_tax_digest_one: 1 adhd-tax item tracked this month — ${0} total
push.adhd_tax_digest_many: ${0} adhd-tax items tracked this month — ${1} total

export.label: export
export.description: all exports are encrypted with a passphrase you choose. tax records stay on your device until you share them.
export.pdf_description: a four-page pdf. cover, month-by-month, categorized, year-over-year. encrypted in the same envelope as the csv path.
export.passphrase_body: choose a passphrase. you will need it to open this file later. 16+ characters. ollie cannot recover it for you.

impulse.footer: pause stays pending if you close this. resolve later from the held list.

health.birth_control_hint: shows daily pill check + missed-dose notification
